versions.content: If RteDevErrorDetectUninit is enabled, an RTE_E_UNINIT (0x07) shall be reported by the Basic Software Scheduler / RTE when one of the APIs SchM_Switch , SchM_Mode , SchM_SwitchAck , SchM_Trigger , SchM_Send , SchM_Receive , SchM_Call , SchM_Result , SchM_ActMainFunction , SchM_- Start , SchM_StartTiming , or Rte_Start is called before SchM_Init .
